description: Land Acquisition - Acquire the Lands in D/S Division's Kalutara, Dickwella, Welimada & Homagama
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple orders directing acquiring officers to take possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of location, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions without involving government personnel changes, structural reforms, or other specialized categories.
